summary: This note is a short encyclopedic entry describing the Ministry of National Defense of Ecuador. It states that the ministry is responsible for national defense and for controlling all three branches of the Military of Ecuador.
one_line: Overview of Ecuador's Ministry of National Defense, the body overseeing national defense and the country's three military branches.
key_facts: The Ministry of National Defense of the Republic of Ecuador is the ministry responsible for national defense.
The Ministry of National Defense is responsible for controlling all three branches of the Military of Ecuador.
